0022600087.text: Both the Brooklyn Nets and Charlotte Hornets open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with Brooklyn at home. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee), all listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, and no Nets players are listed as unavailable. The Nets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 117-86 loss in Brooklyn on March 31, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Brooklyn a 40% chance to win.
